critical_code_review_comments: CreateCustomerDto.ensureHasIdentifier is invoked from the controller (line 23) rather than as a ValidationPipe transform. Functionally correct, but it bypasses the global ValidationPipe and won't auto-collect alongside other class-validator errors. Consider migrating to a custom @ValidatorConstraint so the response shape is consistent with other 400s (single 'message' array vs. flat string).

EmployeeDetail.jsx fetches /api/payroll/employees/:id/history and renders 4 events for Hemant. Confirm a loading/empty/error state exists for new employees with zero history (initial_offer is auto-created so an empty array shouldn't occur, but client should still tolerate []). Visually verified UI for the happy path only.

AedWioTab extraction is clean — 5 props, no leaking state. The 'Import Wio Bank Statement' modal still lives in Treasury.jsx and is triggered via openImportBank prop callback — fine for now. If the modal grows, consider extracting it into AedWioTab so the dependency boundary stays tight.

Treasury.jsx is now 1530 lines (down from ~1661 in iter24). OKX/Binance unified tab is still inline and heavily state-coupled per main agent's note; would require a Treasury context wrapper to extract cleanly.

rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found this iteration. iter24's pre-existing DTO gap is resolved: CreateCustomerDto now (a) enforces field-level validation via class-validator decorators (IsEmail, IsString, MaxLength, IsIn) and (b) calls ensureHasIdentifier() in the controller to enforce the 'at least one identifier' multi-field rule that ValidationPipe can't express natively.
